title: Storage units
purpose: Find freezers, vapor-phase tanks and other storage units, and see how full each is. Open a unit for its racks, shelves and boxes.
summary: Find freezers, vapor-phase tanks and other storage units and see how full each is.

tasks.title: Find a unit with room
steps: Set [[Free positions]] to Has free positions and select [[Apply]].
Select the number in the [[Free]] column to see available positions in that storage unit.

tasks.title: Add a storage unit
steps: Admin and manager: select [[New storage unit]]. To create a whole layout at once, apply a storage template instead.

good_to_know: Only active units are listed until you change [[Status]].
Counts cover active boxes in active racks and shelves only.
Nominal temperature is a stated set point, not a measurement.

sections.title: Search, filters and sorting
paragraphs: Search matches part of the unit code or name, ignoring capitals.
Without a status filter only active units are listed.
Click a sortable column heading to sort by it; click again to reverse. Ties keep a stable order. Choose 25, 50 or 100 rows per page; the default is 25.

items.label: Site, Room
items.description: Limit to a site or room.

items.label: Free positions
items.description: Any, Has free positions, or No free positions.

items.label: Technology
items.description: LN2 vapor phase, LN2 liquid phase, Mechanical freezer or refrigerator, or Ambient.

items.label: Status
items.description: Active (the default), Retired, or Active and retired. Some filters sit under the More control, which opens by itself when one of them is set.

items.label: Code
items.description: Immutable unit code; opens the unit. Always shown.

items.label: Room
items.description: Site code / room code; opens the room. Sortable.

items.label: Storage class
items.description: Class name. Sortable by class code.

items.label: Nominal (°C)
items.description: Stated set point in degrees Celsius, not a measurement. Sortable.

items.label: Positions, Blocked, Occupied, Free
items.description: Counts cover installed positions in the unit. Only active storage contributes to capacity. Free is the total minus blocked and occupied positions. Select a positive Free count to list those positions. Zero has no link. Opening the list does not reserve a position. Occupied and Free are sortable.

items.label: Status
items.description: Active, or Retired once the record has been retired.

items.label: Export CSV
items.description: Downloads all matching rows across pages as a UTF-8 CSV in the order shown. Anyone who can read this list can export it. Correct invalid filters or narrow the selection to 10,000 rows or fewer to see Export CSV. An empty selection downloads just the column headings. If the selection grows past 10,000 rows before you download, you return to this list with your filters and sort order. Narrow the selection and try again. Cells that a spreadsheet could read as a formula are prefixed with an apostrophe, and numbers are exact decimals. The audit trail records who exported the selection and the number of data rows in the CSV. An over-limit request produces no download or export event.

items.label: New storage unit
items.description: Opens the create form. Shown only to the admin and manager roles.

items.label: No records yet
items.description: Shown when nothing has been defined. Users who may create records see the create button in the message.

items.label: Nothing matches these filters
items.description: The search or filters exclude every row. Change or clear them.

items.label: These filters cannot be applied
items.description: A filter value was not valid. The list shows no rows rather than all rows; correct the highlighted filter.
